units.source_text: 源氏公子的宫邸桐壶院内，侍女甚多，此时有数人已经睡醒。

en.t: In Prince Genji's residence, the Kiritsubo Palace, there were many serving women, and by now several of them had already awakened.

units.source_text: 她们看见公子破晓归来，便扯手踢脚，交头接耳地互相告道：“好辛苦！

en.t: When they saw the prince return at daybreak, they tugged at one another's hands, nudged with their feet, and whispered together, "How exhausting!
Day and night, sneaking about here and there!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子走进内室，虽然躺下，但不能入睡。

en.t: Prince Genji went into the inner room and lay down, but he could not fall asleep.

units.source_text: 心中寻思：“这个人儿真可爱！

en.t: In his heart he thought, "That young woman is truly lovely!

units.source_text: 大约是弘徽殿女御诸妹中之一人吧。

en.t: She is probably one of the younger sisters of the Kokiden Consort.

units.source_text: 此人还是处女，想必是五女公子或六女公子了。

en.t: Since she is still unmarried, she must be either the fifth princess or the sixth princess.

units.source_text: 帅皇子[\[5\]](#part1337.html#m5)的夫人三女公子和头中将所不爱的夫人四女公子，听说都是美人。

en.t: I have heard that the third princess, wife of the Commander Prince[\[5\]](#part1337.html#m5), and the fourth princess, the wife unloved by the Captain Secretary, are both beauties.

units.source_text: 倘是这两个人，更加有味儿了。

en.t: If she were one of those two, that would make it all the more intriguing.

units.source_text: 六女公子已经许给皇太子，如果是她，倒有些对人不起。

en.t: The sixth princess has already been promised to the Crown Prince, so if it was she, I would feel somewhat guilty toward him.

units.source_text: 她们姐妹众多，难于辨别，我真弄不清楚。

en.t: There are so many sisters that they are hard to tell apart; I truly cannot be sure.

units.source_text: 看她的样子，不想就此绝交。

en.t: From the way she behaved, she did not seem to want to break things off here.

units.source_text: 那么为何不肯告诉我通信办法呢？”

en.t: Then why would she refuse to tell me how to correspond with her?"

units.source_text: 他左思右想，一颗心儿被这女子牵住了。

en.t: He turned it over and over in his mind, and his whole heart was held fast by this woman.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿如此帷薄不修，而藤壶院如此门禁森严，两相比较之下，他觉得藤壶皇后的人品真可钦敬！

en.t: Kokiden was so lax in its household discipline, while Fujitsubo's residence was so strictly guarded; comparing the two, he felt that Empress Fujitsubo's character was truly worthy of admiration.
